programs.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
programs.desc: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

programs.title: Guillaume's French Atlantic
programs.desc: Chef Brahimi takes viewers on an extraordinary expedition through the captivating land between the Loire and Dordogne rivers for an unforgettable exploration of the region's castles and culture.

programs.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
programs.desc: Analiese tackles the ups-and-downs of her new life, going on her first wallaby hunt and dealing with the wild rabbits that are decimating her garden, resulting in a delicious braised rabbit stew.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: Rick tries out a new recipe - pork chops with a sloe berry sauce, before heading to the village of Rock, where his son, Jack, holds a clam bake on the shore of the Camel Estuary.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programs.desc: The town of Launceston is bypassed by many who visit Cornwall, yet Rick discovers it's home to an unusual superstition. Rick rounds off his trip cooking an alfresco dish of Cornish mussels with cider.

programs.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programs.desc: In Rio de Janeiro, Anthony learns how to be a Carioca and cook like one too. Feijoada, Brazil's national dish, is also featured.
